description: Gröna Lund's main restaurant serving food from all corners of the world in a vibrant atmosphere. A great spot for families looking for a hearty meal in the heart of the park.

description: A vibrant Asian restaurant serving sushi, noodles and bibimbap with amazing views over the park and water. A popular choice for guests looking for lighter and fresh flavours between rides.

description: A cosy Swedish cafe and restaurant with panoramic views over the entire park. Serving traditional Swedish dishes, coffee and cakes in a relaxed atmosphere — perfect for a break between rides.
